injuries.name: Linus Ullmark
injuries.note: Ullmark was placed on injured reserve after suffering the injury during Wednesday's game against Florida, so we already knew that he'd miss at least a week, and it seems he's not expected to miss much more than that. The 33-year-old has a 7-1-0 record, 1.33 GAA and .945 save percentage in eight appearances this campaign. Jonas Johansson has been called up from the minors, and he's set to be Samuel Ersson's understudy for Thursday's home game against San Jose.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Kurtis MacDermid
injuries.note: MacDermid doesn't have a timeline for his return. He contributed one assist, four shots on goal, 18 hits and 33 PIM in 19 appearances for Ottawa during the 2025-26 regular season.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: It was relayed Sept. 17 that Musty will be out long term due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on IR-NR doesn't come as a surprise. The 21-year-old had a relatively solid first full season with AHL San Jose in 2025-26, accounting for 21 goals, 45 points and a minus-14 rating over 61 regular-season games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.

injuries.name: Thomas Chabot
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Senators announced Monday (Oct. 19) that Chabot is expected to miss 1-2 weeks, as per Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Kurtis MacDermid
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Ottawa Senators placed F Kurtis MacDermid on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Linus Ullmark
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Ottawa Senators placed G Linus Ullmark on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 22).

injuries.name: Igor Chernyshov
injuries.note: Upper Body: Chernyshov will be out for a little while with the injury he sustained Thursday (Oct. 22) versus the Senators, Sheng Peng of San Jose Hockey Now reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks placed G Kyle Keyser on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: Upper body: The San Jose Sharks placed F Quentin Musty on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Alexander Wennberg
injuries.note: Upper body: The Sharks said on Thursday (Oct. 22) that Wennberg has been deemed week-to-week by head coach Ryan Warsofsky, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.
